item.title: Exact Copy App Ad

exact_text: Plan your day in one place.

turns.text: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 ad for my fictional planning app DayNest. Three equal-length scenes with these exact lines, one per scene in this order: 'Less scrolling. More doing.' / 'Plan your day in one place.' / 'Try DayNest today.' Keep capitals and punctuation exactly. No other visible words, even in the background. Use simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green.

item.tests: Renders exact ordered on-screen copy with correct punctuation and no extraneous text in a landscape app ad.

answer_sheet.Exact on-screen copy:
Scene 1: Less scrolling. More doing.
Scene 2: Plan your day in one place.
Scene 3: Try DayNest today.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and green with simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes; layout and font are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Silent; English text exactly as supplied.

must_haves: The final video is 9 seconds long, landscape 9:16, with three equal 3-second scenes.
The first scene reads exactly 'Less scrolling. More doing.'
The second scene reads exactly 'Plan your day in one place.'
The third scene reads exactly 'Try DayNest today.'
Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and without altered capitalization or punctuation.
The video is silent and uses cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation.
After the follow-up, the final result is vertical 9:16 (the user changed the shape from widescreen 16:9); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it vertical, for stories, and keep everything else exactly the same.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 motion-graphics concept advertisement for the fictional planning app DayNest. Exactly three scenes, each exactly 3 seconds, separated by clean hard cuts at 3.0 and 6.0 seconds. Minimal flat vector design, warm cream background and forest-green / sage-green shapes, generous negative space, locked camera. Only simple animated calendar outlines, blank calendar cells and checkmark shapes. Calendar graphics must have NO letters, numbers, weekday names or labels. Absolutely no visible text anywhere except the single specified line per scene. No logos, watermarks, interface labels, extra brand names, subtitles or background words. Crisp large centered typography, easy to read, keep each exact line fully visible throughout its scene with no typing animation. Scene 1, 0.0–3.0 seconds: exact text 'Less scrolling. More doing.' rendered without quote marks, preserving all capitals and punctuation. A simple green calendar outline with blank cells gently slides into place below the text, a green checkmark appears inside one blank cell. Scene 2, 3.0–6.0 seconds: replace previous text entirely with exact text 'Plan your day in one place.' without quote marks, preserving capitals and punctuation. Blank cream calendar tiles neatly align within a green calendar outline, with a single simple checkmark. Scene 3, 6.0–9.0 seconds: replace previous text entirely with exact text 'Try DayNest today.' without quote marks, preserving capitals and punctuation exactly, including capital D and N in DayNest. A large green checkmark settles gently beside a small blank calendar shape. No other visible words, even in the background. No spoken words, no music, no sound effects; completely silent. Smooth restrained shape animation; typography remains stationary and legible. End at exactly 9 seconds.
